name: EPUB E-Book
details: Full native parsing and reader support for EPUB E-Book. Metadata extraction: OPF metadata (title, author, publisher, rights, description, language, dates). Cover: OPF manifest cover-image or first image in spine fallback.
limitations: Complex proprietary EPUB 3 JavaScript widgets disabled by offline security sandbox

name: Kindle / MOBI Document
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Kindle / MOBI Document. Metadata extraction: PDB/MOBI header + EXTH records 100 (author), 101 (publisher), 103 (description), 503 (title). Cover: EXTH cover record or first embedded image from PalmDOC image records.
limitations: KF8/AZW3 CSS layout fidelity simplified into standardized reflowable HTML sections

name: Kobo EPUB
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Kobo EPUB. Metadata extraction: OPF package metadata extraction identical to standard EPUB. Cover: OPF manifest cover-image item.
limitations: Kobo proprietary store sync metadata ignored in offline mode

name: FictionBook 2
details: Full native parsing and reader support for FictionBook 2. Metadata extraction: <description><title-info> tags (book-title, author, genre, annotation, coverpage). Cover: <coverpage><image xlink:href="..."> base64 binary block extraction.
limitations: Custom inline stylesheets in FB2 poems/epigraphs normalized to active reader theme

name: Compressed FictionBook (FBZ)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Compressed FictionBook (FBZ). Metadata extraction: Inherited from inner FB2 document description. Cover: Inner FB2 coverpage binary block.
limitations: Multi-book FBZ archives open the first encountered .fb2 entry

name: DjVu Document
details: Full native parsing and reader support for DjVu Document. Metadata extraction: DJVU INFO chunk metadata and page count. Cover: First page bitmap preview.
limitations: Hidden OCR text layer search is basic; high-DPI zoom requires memory pagination

name: Compiled HTML Help (CHM)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Compiled HTML Help (CHM). Metadata extraction: #SYSTEM and #WINDOWS internal stream properties + /#STRINGS. Cover: Default topic first image or generated title palette thumbnail.
limitations: Proprietary MS HTML Help index files (.hhk) may have partial hierarchy fidelity

name: Portable Document Format
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Portable Document Format. Metadata extraction: PDF Info dictionary + XMP metadata (Title, Author, Subject, Creator, Producer). Cover: First page rendered canvas thumbnail.
limitations: Form field filling and interactive digital signatures not supported (read-only)

name: Plain Text Document
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Plain Text Document. Metadata extraction: Filename and file byte stats; first line heading heuristic. Cover: Title-derived typographic palette thumbnail.
limitations: Lacks structural chapter TOC unless formatted with standardized line dividers

name: Markdown Document
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Markdown Document. Metadata extraction: YAML frontmatter metadata block (title, author, date, tags). Cover: First markdown image reference or typographic badge.
limitations: Complex LaTeX math blocks rendered as preformatted code blocks

name: Microsoft Word (DOCX)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Microsoft Word (DOCX). Metadata extraction: docProps/core.xml (dc:title, dc:creator, cp:lastModifiedBy). Cover: docProps/thumbnail.wmf/.jpeg or first embedded media image.
limitations: Complex Word floating shape canvas and WordArt rendered inline

name: Microsoft Word 97-2003 (DOC)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Microsoft Word 97-2003 (DOC). Metadata extraction: SummaryInformation stream (PIDSI_TITLE, PIDSI_AUTHOR, PIDSI_SUBJECT). Cover: Typographic document card with Word icon badge.
limitations: Proprietary binary drawing shapes and complex tables rendered as sequential text runs

name: OpenDocument Text (ODT)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for OpenDocument Text (ODT). Metadata extraction: meta.xml (dc:title, dc:creator, meta:document-statistic). Cover: Thumbnails/thumbnail.png or first Pictures/ embedded graphic.
limitations: Frames with absolute page positioning rendered sequentially in flow order

name: Rich Text Format (RTF)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Rich Text Format (RTF). Metadata extraction: {\info {\title ...}{\author ...}} control groups. Cover: Typographic badge thumbnail.
limitations: Complex RTF drawing objects (\do) and nested tables flattened

name: XML Paper Specification (XPS)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for XML Paper Specification (XPS). Metadata extraction: docProps/core.xml (title, creator, description). Cover: First page rendered SVG preview.
limitations: Proprietary OpenType obfuscated font GUIDs may fall back to system sans-serif

name: Comma-Separated Values
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Comma-Separated Values. Metadata extraction: File statistics, row count, column count, header row names. Cover: Tabular green-accent grid badge.
limitations: Single sheet representation without formula computation

name: Tab-Separated Values
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Tab-Separated Values. Metadata extraction: Row and column counts, header labels. Cover: Tabular grid badge with TSV label.
limitations: Single sheet layout

name: Microsoft Excel (XLSX)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Microsoft Excel (XLSX). Metadata extraction: docProps/core.xml + workbook sheet names. Cover: Multi-sheet workbook preview badge with sheet tabs.
limitations: Displays calculated values; live Excel formula calculation engine not executed

name: Microsoft Excel 97-2003 (XLS)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Microsoft Excel 97-2003 (XLS). Metadata extraction: SummaryInformation stream + BIFF8 sheet directory table. Cover: Green Excel legacy badge with sheet count.
limitations: Legacy charts and pivot tables omitted; cell values and strings rendered accurately

name: OpenDocument Spreadsheet (ODS)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for OpenDocument Spreadsheet (ODS). Metadata extraction: meta.xml (title, creator, date) + sheet list. Cover: ODS grid badge thumbnail.
limitations: Complex formula matrices display stored text values

name: Macro-Enabled Excel Workbook (XLSM)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Macro-Enabled Excel Workbook (XLSM). Metadata extraction: docProps/core.xml properties. Cover: Workbook badge with macro-inert shield indicator.
limitations: Macros are completely inert; user macros cannot run

name: Microsoft Excel Template (XLTX)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Microsoft Excel Template (XLTX). Metadata extraction: Core properties and sheet names. Cover: Template grid card badge.
limitations: Saved formulas display pre-calculated default values

name: Microsoft Excel Binary Workbook (XLSB)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Microsoft Excel Binary Workbook (XLSB). Metadata extraction: Workbook sheet list and record counts. Cover: Excel binary grid card badge.
limitations: Cell comments and advanced chart shapes not displayed

name: Microsoft PowerPoint (PPTX)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Microsoft PowerPoint (PPTX). Metadata extraction: docProps/core.xml + slide count. Cover: First slide rendered thumbnail or embedded slide thumbnail.
limitations: Rendered as structured slide cards with text, headings, and images; complex animations and transitions omitted

name: Microsoft PowerPoint 97-2003 (PPT)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Microsoft PowerPoint 97-2003 (PPT). Metadata extraction: SummaryInformation properties (title, subject, author). Cover: PowerPoint legacy orange badge thumbnail.
limitations: Legacy binary drawing shapes simplified into clean slide text sections

name: OpenDocument Presentation (ODP)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for OpenDocument Presentation (ODP). Metadata extraction: meta.xml properties + page count. Cover: Thumbnails/thumbnail.png or first slide preview.
limitations: Slide card view without vector shape morphing animations

name: PowerPoint Slide Show (PPSX)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for PowerPoint Slide Show (PPSX). Metadata extraction: Slide count and core metadata. Cover: First slide card thumbnail.
limitations: Displays slides sequentially as reader cards

name: Comic Book Archive (CBZ)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Comic Book Archive (CBZ). Metadata extraction: ComicInfo.xml metadata (series, issue, writer, penciller, volume) or filename stats. Cover: First sorted raster image file extracted as thumbnail.
limitations: Encrypted ZIP archives require password entry or are rejected

name: Comic Book Archive (CBR)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Comic Book Archive (CBR). Metadata extraction: ComicInfo.xml within archive or file entry count. Cover: First sequential image in archive.
limitations: Android RarExtractor currently supports uncompressed and RAR4 standard streams; RAR5 solid archives have documented limitations

name: Comic Book Archive (CBT)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Comic Book Archive (CBT). Metadata extraction: Entry count and filenames. Cover: First image file extracted from TAR archive.
limitations: Sparse TAR records normalized

name: Comic Book Archive (CB7)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Comic Book Archive (CB7). Metadata extraction: Archive header entry count. Cover: First image entry in archive.
limitations: Complex multi-volume solid 7Z archives not supported offline

name: JPEG Image
details: Full native parsing and reader support for JPEG Image. Metadata extraction: EXIF metadata header sniffing (orientation, dimensions). Cover: Native image thumbnail scaling.
limitations: Single image document view

name: Portable Network Graphics (PNG)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Portable Network Graphics (PNG). Metadata extraction: IHDR chunk dimensions, tEXt/zTXt metadata. Cover: Native PNG thumbnail.
limitations: Single image document view

name: WebP Image
details: Full native parsing and reader support for WebP Image. Metadata extraction: VP8/VP8X chunk dimensions and features. Cover: Direct WebP thumbnail.
limitations: Animated WebP displays the primary frame in static reader mode

name: Graphics Interchange Format (GIF)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Graphics Interchange Format (GIF). Metadata extraction: Logical screen descriptor dimensions. Cover: Direct GIF thumbnail.
limitations: Animated GIFs play in an offline loop without scrub controls

name: Windows Bitmap (BMP)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Windows Bitmap (BMP). Metadata extraction: DIB header dimensions and bit depth. Cover: Direct BMP thumbnail.
limitations: Uncompressed high-resolution BMPs consume memory proportional to resolution

name: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG). Metadata extraction: <title> and <desc> elements. Cover: Vector rendered badge thumbnail.
limitations: Embedded animations (<animate>) disabled by offline security sanitizer

name: Tagged Image File Format (TIFF)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Tagged Image File Format (TIFF). Metadata extraction: IFD tags (image width, length, compression, resolution). Cover: First IFD rendered thumbnail.
limitations: Multi-page TIFF documents currently display the primary image frame

name: AV1 Image File Format (AVIF)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for AV1 Image File Format (AVIF). Metadata extraction: ISOBMFF meta box dimensions. Cover: Direct AVIF thumbnail.
limitations: Android 10/11 devices without hardware AV1 decoder require platform codec fallback

name: High Efficiency Image Container (HEIC)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for High Efficiency Image Container (HEIC). Metadata extraction: ISOBMFF EXIF box extraction. Cover: Extracted primary frame thumbnail.
limitations: Apple live photo video tracks ignored (displays primary high-res still)

name: High Efficiency Image Format (HEIF)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for High Efficiency Image Format (HEIF). Metadata extraction: ISOBMFF meta properties. Cover: Extracted primary frame thumbnail.
limitations: Multi-frame image sequences display the primary still frame

name: HTML Document
details: Full native parsing and reader support for HTML Document. Metadata extraction: and <meta name="author"> tags. Cover: First <img> element or styled HTML badge thumbnail.
limitations: Interactive web forms and client-side JavaScript apps rendered as static documents

name: MHTML Web Archive
details: Full native parsing and reader support for MHTML Web Archive. Metadata extraction: Subject, Date, and From MIME headers. Cover: First embedded image part or web archive card badge.
limitations: Dynamic web scripts embedded in saved archives disabled for privacy

name: XML Document
details: Full native parsing and reader support for XML Document. Metadata extraction: Root element tag name and XML attributes. Cover: Code/XML structured badge thumbnail.
limitations: Display mode presents syntax-highlighted hierarchical tree rather than arbitrary XSLT layouts

name: JSON Document
details: Full native parsing and reader support for JSON Document. Metadata extraction: Top-level key count and schema keys. Cover: Code bracket badge thumbnail.
limitations: Files larger than 20MB load with virtualization

name: YAML Document
details: Full native parsing and reader support for YAML Document. Metadata extraction: Top-level dictionary keys. Cover: YAML document badge thumbnail.
limitations: Multi-document streams separated by "---" rendered sequentially

name: Log File
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Log File. Metadata extraction: Line count, timestamp range (first and last log entries). Cover: Terminal log badge thumbnail.
limitations: Files > 50MB view latest windowed segments

name: Email Message (EML)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for Email Message (EML). Metadata extraction: From, To, Cc, Subject, Date headers. Cover: Email letter envelope badge thumbnail.
limitations: S/MIME encrypted email bodies require external certificate configuration

name: vCard Contact (VCF)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for vCard Contact (VCF). Metadata extraction: FN (full name), ORG (organization), EMAIL, TEL. Cover: PHOTO property base64 image or avatar initial badge.
limitations: Multi-contact address books display contacts as sequential cards

name: iCalendar Event (ICS)
details: Full native parsing and reader support for iCalendar Event (ICS). Metadata extraction: SUMMARY, DTSTART, DTEND, LOCATION, DESCRIPTION. Cover: Calendar page badge with event date indicator.
limitations: Read-only schedule inspection; calendar writing requires user system app export

name: ZIP Archive Container
details: Archive container inspected for book and document import; not a direct reading format
limitations: Archive container only; directly opened archives inspect internal entries rather than rendering as a single book.

name: RAR Archive Container
details: Archive container inspected for book and document import; not a direct reading format
limitations: Archive container only; directly opened archives inspect internal entries rather than rendering as a single book.

name: 7-Zip Archive Container
details: Archive container inspected for book and document import; not a direct reading format
limitations: Archive container only; directly opened archives inspect internal entries rather than rendering as a single book.
